transcript: I woke, said the proprietor, and went to the window, and the lamps went white. He turned his head from the harbour window and looked down the length of the table at Kiva. I've dreamed it eleven times since. Not often, not on any night I could choose. Always with a fever, and always near a thing I can't name, and never once since 2611 when I didn't have my hand on this glass. The last was in the ninth month of last year, the seventeenth, in the evening.
